metaShifts.description: Systematic removal of ethereal form application on debuff immune targets across Ghost Scepter, Ethereal Blade, Necrophos Ghost Shroud, Pugna Decrepify, and Leshrac Nihilism. This creates consistent counterplay where BKB/debuff immunity completely negates ethereal-based saves and nukes, significantly weakening spell-based burst strategies and ethereal form defensive plays.

Heavy nerfs to Helm of Dominator/Overlord with mana costs, damage-based lockouts, and movement speed reduction. Combined with neutral creep stacking penalty increase from 15% to 20%, this systematically weakens jungle control and creep manipulation strategies, forcing more direct engagement rather than economic/map control through dominated units.

Final wave of nerfs to remaining spell-dominant heroes: Earthshaker damage reduction, Queen of Pain ultimate nerf, Sven strength scaling cut, Disruptor cooldown increase. This completes the systematic dismantling of the spell-heavy meta that began in 7.39b/c, fully establishing physical damage dealers as the dominant paradigm.

Small but meaningful buffs to struggling lane supports: Lich intelligence/damage, Venomancer agility/ward damage, Omniknight cast range, Jakiro Liquid Frost improvements. These changes attempt to restore viability to traditional lane support heroes who were overshadowed by the spell-heavy meta, providing them with better laning presence and utility scaling.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Ethereal form immunity standardization makes BKB the ultimate counter to ethereal-based saves and nukes. Physical damage cores who naturally build BKB (PA, Sven, Lifestealer) can now completely ignore Ghost Scepter saves and Ethereal Blade nukes, creating massive windows of vulnerability for previously safe targets.

synergisticWinners.entity: Razor + Static Link Buff + Anti-Spell Meta
synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Static Link cooldown reduction from 50/40/30/20s to 44/36/28/20s combined with the systematic weakening of spell-heavy heroes creates perfect conditions for Razor. He can more frequently steal damage from physical cores while the meta shift away from spell burst makes his natural magic resistance and consistent damage output extremely valuable.

synergisticWinners.entity: Lina + Stun Buff + Support Meta Shift
synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Light Strike Array stun duration increase from 1/1.4/1.8/2.2s to 1.2/1.6/2.0/2.4s combined with lane support micro-buffs positions Lina perfectly. As spell-heavy mids get nerfed, Lina transitions to support role with significantly improved disable duration, making her a premier setup support in the new physical-focused meta.

synergisticWinners.entity: Treant Protector + Living Armor + Physical Meta
synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Base armor increase and Living Armor buff from 4/6/8/10 to 4/7/10/13 creates exceptional synergy with the shift toward physical damage. As the meta moves away from spell burst, Treant's armor-based protection becomes exponentially more valuable, making him the ultimate counter to physical-heavy lineups.

synergisticLosers.entity: Ghost Scepter + Ethereal Blade + Spell Burst Combos
synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: The ethereal form immunity standardization completely destroys the classic Ghost Scepter save into Ethereal Blade nuke combo. BKB users can no longer be ethereal'd, eliminating a core defensive/offensive synergy that defined spell-heavy team compositions and making ethereal-based strategies fundamentally unreliable.

synergisticLosers.entity: Helm Domination + Jungle Stacking + Economic Control
synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Helm nerfs (mana cost, damage lockout, movement speed) combined with increased neutral creep stacking penalty (15% to 20%) destroys the economic control synergy. Heroes who relied on dominated creeps for jungle manipulation and gold acceleration lose both the reliability and efficiency of this strategy.

Refresher cooldown scaling (increases by 10s per use up to 210s) and mana cost increase from 350 to 400 eliminates multiple-refresh strategies. Combined with the spell-heavy meta correction, heroes who relied on double ultimates for teamfight dominance lose both the mechanical reliability and meta relevance of this approach.

synergisticLosers.entity: Queen of Pain + Spell Burst + Ethereal Setups
synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Sonic Wave damage reduction from 350/500/650 to 325/475/625 combined with ethereal form immunity changes eliminates QoP's burst potential. She can no longer rely on Ethereal Blade setups for guaranteed kills, and her raw damage output is insufficient in the new physical-focused meta.

Carry.explanation: Immaterial evasion buff from 20/30/40/50% to 25/35/45/55% combined with ethereal immunity standardization makes her nearly untouchable. Ghost Scepter can no longer save targets from her crits during BKB, and the meta shift toward physical damage makes her evasion exponentially more valuable.

Despite the Feast nerf on hero creeps, the ethereal immunity changes and spell-heavy meta correction massively favor Lifestealer. His built-in magic immunity becomes premium in a meta where BKB timing determines fights, and physical damage focus plays to his percentage-based damage strengths.

Mid.explanation: Static Link cooldown reduction from 50/40/30/20s to 44/36/28/20s makes him the premier anti-carry mid. With spell-heavy mids nerfed systematically, Razor's ability to steal damage and survive magic burst positions him as the ideal mid for the physical-focused meta.

Arcane Orb cooldown reduction from 6/4/2/0s to 4.5/3/1.5/0s significantly improves his laning and farming efficiency. As spell-burst mids get nerfed, OD's consistent magical damage and mana burn become more valuable, especially against physical cores who rely on mana for abilities.

Offlane.explanation: Base armor increase combined with the meta shift away from spell burst makes Brewmaster's ultimate exponentially more valuable. Physical damage cores struggle against his split forms, and the reduction in spell-heavy heroes means his magic resistance becomes less relevant while his teamfight control dominates.

Reactive Armor buff from 3 to 4 stacks per hero attack combined with the physical meta shift creates perfect synergy. As the meta moves toward physical damage dealers, Timbersaw's armor stacking becomes exponentially more effective, making him nearly unkillable against physical lineups.

SoftSupport.explanation: Light Strike Array stun duration increase from 1/1.4/1.8/2.2s to 1.2/1.6/2.0/2.4s transforms her support viability. With spell-heavy mids nerfed, Lina transitions perfectly to support role with premium disable duration for setting up physical damage cores.

Liquid Frost damage increase from 10/15/20/25 to 15/20/25/30 and duration buff from 4s to 5s significantly improves his laning presence. The lane support micro-buff initiative specifically targets heroes like Jakiro who were overshadowed by spell-heavy supports.

HardSupport.explanation: Base armor increase and Living Armor buff from 4/6/8/10 to 4/7/10/13 makes him the ultimate counter to physical-heavy lineups. As the meta shifts toward physical damage, Treant's armor-based protection becomes exponentially more valuable for keeping cores alive.

Base intelligence increase from 26 to 28 and damage buff creates better laning presence. The lane support micro-buff initiative specifically addresses Lich's struggles against spell-heavy supports, giving him the tools to compete in the new support meta.

Carry.explanation: Mana Shield damage per mana reduction from 2.2 to 2.0 significantly weakens her tankiness scaling. In a meta shifting toward physical damage where her survivability should theoretically improve, this nerf undermines her core defensive mechanism, making her less effective at her primary role of late-game teamfight anchor.

Wrath of God strength scaling nerf from 0/0.3/0.4/0.5 to 0/0.2/0.3/0.4 per STR significantly reduces his late-game damage potential. Despite the physical meta shift that should favor him, this direct nerf to his scaling makes him less effective as a hard carry compared to other physical damage dealers.

Mid.explanation: Sonic Wave damage reduction from 350/500/650 to 325/475/625 combined with ethereal immunity changes eliminates her burst potential. She can no longer rely on Ethereal Blade setups, and her damage output is insufficient for mid-game dominance in the physical-focused meta.

Aftershock damage reduction from 70/100/130/160 to 65/90/115/140 and talent nerf significantly weakens his mid-game impact. As a spell-heavy hero in a meta moving toward physical damage, these nerfs compound his already declining relevance in the current paradigm.

Offlane.explanation: Base damage reduction by 2 and multiple talent nerfs (movement speed from +20 to +15) significantly weaken his laning and mid-game presence. The domination mechanic restrictions also indirectly hurt his creep control strategies, making him less effective at his core offlane role of map control and initiation.

Work Horse cast range reduction from 300 to 250 weakens his initiation and save potential. In a meta where positioning becomes more critical due to reduced vision control, this range nerf makes him less effective at his primary offlane role of creating space and initiating fights.

SoftSupport.explanation: Static Storm cooldown increase from 90/80/70s to 100/85/70s significantly reduces his teamfight frequency. As a spell-heavy support in a meta moving toward physical damage, this cooldown nerf makes him less reliable for the frequent skirmishes that define the current game pace.

Firesnap Cookie cast range reduction from 700 to 650 weakens her positioning and save potential. In a meta where precise positioning becomes more critical, this range nerf makes her less effective at her support role of enabling cores and providing utility.

HardSupport.explanation: Enfeeble cast range reduction from 800/900/1000/1100 to 700/800/900/1000 significantly weakens his laning harassment and teamfight positioning. In a meta where supports need to stay further back due to physical damage threats, this range nerf makes him more vulnerable while performing his core disable role.

Arcane Curse cast range reduction from 1000 to 850 weakens his laning presence and teamfight positioning. As a spell-heavy support in a meta moving toward physical damage, this range nerf compounds his declining relevance by forcing him into more dangerous positions to be effective.
